rationale: Plan implements the task specification: 25% test holdout with stratified target definition at 95th percentile of paid_amount. Features include clinical and service characteristics (claim type, diagnosis, place of service, provider specialty, service patterns, authorization flags) and correlated amounts (billed, allowed), excluding target variable and identifiers. Standardization supports logistic regression performance while random forest provides robustness. Preprocessing fitted on training data only to prevent information leakage. Report includes essential caveats on model limitations, class imbalance of high-cost claims, and the association-not-causation distinction inherent in prediction tasks.
